docs.summary: Represents a 3D plane defined by a normal vector and distance from origin. The plane equation is: Normal � Point = D
The normalized normal vector of the plane.
The distance from the origin to the plane along the normal.

Initializes a new plane from a normal vector and distance. Both the normal and distance will be normalized together to maintain the plane equation. If the normal has length L, the resulting plane will have Normal = normal/L and D = d/L.

params.d: The distance from origin (will be scaled by the normalization factor).
